full_prompt_en: A square painterly landscape image shows a lone dark figure standing in a narrow boat on still water, under a vast wash of yellow-green mist. The background is almost entirely atmospheric color. It shifts from dull olive at the upper left to bright citron yellow near the upper right, then thickens into a softer yellow haze at the waterline. Faintly behind that veil, toward the upper center-right, rises the silhouette of a distant ornate tower with a tall pointed spire and several smaller pinnacles. The structure has no sharp facade detail; its vertical outline is softened until it nearly merges with the fog. On the left bank, a close cluster of slender trees spreads into a dark feathery canopy. Their trunks divide near the ground and cast wavering reflections below. A narrow dark strip of shore extends from the left edge, then disappears into the water. The boat occupies a small space just right of center and faces slightly left. Its upturned ends form a low black crescent; the standing figure is no more than a small upright silhouette, with one arm projecting outward. The quiet water fills the lower portion, reflecting the shore and tree trunks in blurred vertical stains. Its surface shows only a few soft horizontal disturbances around the hull. Tiny dark specks appear high in the pale mist, but they remain subordinate to the large color field. Light is diffused everywhere by haze, with the strongest glow behind the distant tower and no hard cast shadows. Soft-edged tonal layering and fine grain give the scene the quality of a misted painting or altered photograph. The composition balances the heavy tree mass at left against the barely visible vertical tower and the minute boat, creating a spacious and hushed atmosphere.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、带绘画感的风景画面呈现一名深色独行者站在静水中的窄船上，周围铺开大片黄绿色雾。背景几乎全由空气色彩构成：左上是暗橄榄色，右上转为明亮的柠檬黄，水线附近则变成更柔软的黄雾。雾幕之后，偏右上方隐约升起一座遥远华丽塔楼的剪影，中央有高尖塔，两旁还有较小尖顶。建筑没有锐利立面细节，竖向轮廓被柔化得几乎融入雾里。左岸近处一簇细树展开成暗而轻羽状的树冠。树干在地面附近分叉，并在水里留下摇晃倒影。一条窄暗岸线从左边伸入，随后消失在水中。船占据中心偏右的一小块，略朝左。两端上翘，形成低矮黑色弯月；站立者只是一枚小小竖直剪影，一只手臂向外伸出。安静水面占据下部，把岸与树干映成模糊竖痕。水面只在船身附近有几道柔弱横向扰动。浅雾高处有细小黑点，但它们服从于大面积色域。光被雾气均匀散开，最亮处在远塔后方，没有坚硬投影。柔边的层层明暗和细微颗粒使场景像蒙雾的绘画或经过处理的照片。构图用左侧沉重树影平衡几乎看不见的远方竖塔与微小船影，形成开阔而静寂的气息。
style_prompt_en: Painterly atmospheric imaging builds depth with broad translucent color veils and soft-edged silhouettes. A restrained olive-to-citron range covers most of the frame, while small dark marks provide scale and visual anchors. Near forms carry more branching detail and textured density; far forms lose internal detail and dissolve into luminous haze. Fine grain and lightly mottled surfaces keep the color wash from becoming perfectly smooth. Horizontal reflection stains answer upright forms without making a mirror-sharp duplicate. Light is dispersed through the whole space and concentrates as a gentle distant glow rather than a hard beam. The composition leaves generous open areas around a few compact masses, creating a quiet rhythm of proximity, disappearance, and depth.
style_prompt_zh: 带绘画感的大气影像以宽阔半透明色雾和柔边剪影建立纵深。克制的橄榄绿至柠檬黄色域覆盖画面大部，小块深暗笔迹提供尺度与视觉锚点。近处形体有更多分枝细节与纹理密度；远处形体失去内部细节，溶入发亮的雾。细颗粒和轻微斑驳使色层不会变成完全光滑的渐变。横向倒影色痕回应竖直形态，却不形成镜面锐利的复制。光散布于整个空间，并凝成柔和远方辉光，而非硬光束。构图在少量紧凑色块四周留下宽敞空域，形成靠近、消失与深入的安静节奏。
theme_en: A lone figure in a narrow boat on misty yellow-green water
theme_zh: 一名独行者乘窄船停在黄绿色雾水上
name: Igor Zenin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
